text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy School Rule—Number One!! 
Sleep well, eat well, run well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rule number one!! Hallways are made for 
sprinting!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rule number one!! Uniforms flawless! 
Horseshoes tight!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Magnificent! Everyone is observing the 
school rules and carrying themselves with 
pride!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The future of the racing world is bright 
indeed! Bwaaa-ha-ha-ha!
